latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video Meme AI.

- Converts static images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF up to 200MB) into animated meme videos with text and sound.
- Enables TikTok-ready 1080p MP4 export in ~20–40 seconds using cloud GPUs.
- Automated connection setup and token handling for seamless onboarding.
- Supports credits checking, task status, and export/download actions with clear user prompts.
- Full cloud render pipeline with session management, file upload, and job polling.
- Provides error handling and workflow tips for smooth editing and export.
